description: Queues local do-not-call lists for import, as if their numbers were uploaded in a file. A list whose name and country already exist is skipped.

items.description: A local do-not-call list and its phone numbers.

Name.description: The name of the list. A list with the same name and country is skipped.

CountryCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the numbers belong to, such as 'US'.

PhoneNumbers.description: The phone numbers, one per item.
